questions.sourceFile: 上海市奉贤区2015届九年级上学期期末（一模）质量监控英语试题及答案（word版）.doc
questions.prompt: After the accident, citizens are wondering ______ about the serious events.

options.B: how will the government take action
options.C: how the government will take action
options.D: if will the government take action

questions.sourceFile: 上海市徐汇区2015届九年级上学期期末（一模）质量监控英语试题及答案（word版）.doc
questions.prompt: If you travel around the world, you will be surprised at ________. A) how different the foreign customs are B) how the foreign customs are different C) how different are the foreign customs D) how are the foreign customs different

options.A: how different the foreign customs are
options.B: how the foreign customs are different
options.C: how different are the foreign customs
options.D: how are the foreign customs different

questions.topicReason: at 后接宾语从句，考查 how 引导的宾语从句语序：how + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市徐汇区2018届九年级上学期期末（一模）质量监控英语试题及答案（word版）.doc
questions.prompt: My mother has little interest in football ______ she didn’t watch the live match on TV yesterday evening.
questions.topicReason: 考查并列连词so表示因果关系，前后分句构成“因为不感兴趣，所以没看”的逻辑。

questions.prompt: It is hard to review the knowledge we learn in class ______ we take notes.

questions.topicReason: 句意为“除非我们开始和他们交谈，否则很难交朋友”，考查条件状语从句连词 unless。

questions.prompt: The golden fish didn’t grant the fisherman’s wish ________ his wife demanded to be queen of all the land.

questions.sourceFile: 上海市松江区2020-2021学年九年级上学期期末（一模）英语试题（解析版）.doc

questions.sourceFile: 上海市静安区2022届九年级上学期期末（一模）质量监控英语试卷（Word解析版 ）.docx
questions.prompt: You’ll lose marks in the exam ________ you check the paper very carefully.
questions.topicReason: 考查条件状语从句连词；句意为“除非你仔细检查试卷，否则会失分”，应用unless。

questions.sourceFile: 精品解析：2023年上海市闵行区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: You should report your trip to the school ________ you travel outside the city.
questions.topicReason: 考查条件状语从句连接词；if 表示“如果”。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市浦东新区2023-2024学年九年级上学期（一模）期末英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: She will finish the project in time ________ the workshop is not available.

options.D: after 【答案】A 【详解】句意：除非这个工作室不能用，否则她会按时完成这个项目。 考查连词。unless除非；if如果；or或者，否则；after在……之后。unless引导的是条件状语从句，除非工作室不能用，是不能完成工作的条件。故选A。

questions.topicReason: 考查unless引导条件状语从句，表示“除非工作室不可用”。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市闵行区2023-2024学年九年级上学期（一模）期末英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: _________ Jessy is only ten years old, she thinks a lot about her future.

options.D: Although 【答案】D 【详解】句意：尽管杰西只有十岁，但她对自己的未来想了很多。 考查连词。When当……时候；If如果；Unless除非；Although尽管。根据“Jessy is only ten years old, she thinks a lot about her future.”可知虽然她只有10岁，但是对未来想了很多，此处是Although引导的让步状语从句。故选D。

questions.topicReason: 考查让步状语从句连接词，Although表示“尽管”。

questions.sourceFile: 2025年上海市普陀区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: You won’t have a chance to win the contest ________ you don’t prepare enough.
questions.topicReason: 考查条件状语从句连词，if引导条件句，表示“如果”。
